findings.title: Occurrence context ignores rewritten schedule_type
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config and, when schedule_type is present, replaces it with monitor.get_schedule_type_display(). The dict it actually returns uses monitor_environment.monitor.config, not that copy, so the rewrite is discarded. Monitor incident events therefore keep the raw schedule_type (typically an int) instead of the display value the copy was built to provide, and the occurrence payload aliases the monitor's live config dict.
